title: Business Addendum to the Northbeam Credit Account Terms
content:
Two terms of the Northbeam Store Credit and Financing Accounts range concern business invoicing: the days a business invoice may run before it is overdue, and whether a purchase order number must be quoted on every draw.

| Product | Days a business invoice may run before it is overdue | Purchase order number quoted on every draw |
|---|---|---|
| Northbeam Store Card | 0 | not required |
| Northbeam Store Card Plus | 0 | not required |
| Northbeam Signature Rewards Card | 0 | not required |
| Northbeam Deferred Interest Promotion Account | 0 | not required |
| Northbeam Business Net Thirty Account | 30 | required |
| Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit | 45 | required |

## The addendum in words

1. Net terms run on the two business products of the range only. The Northbeam Business Net Thirty Account allows an invoice 30 days before it is overdue and the Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit allows 45, so an invoice on the fleet line may run 15 days longer than one on the net account before it stands overdue. The four consumer products carry 0 days of net terms.
2. A purchase order number must be quoted on every draw on the Northbeam Business Net Thirty Account and the Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit. On the four consumer products no purchase order number is required.
